requirement: Soft delete a pathogen and cascade the soft delete to its risk factors and suspected causes inside one transaction, leaving rows of other pathogens untouched, and report an unknown id as not found.

preconditions.text: A live pathogen exists for the target id
Related risk factors and suspected causes reference the pathogen
The target id matches no live pathogen

inputs.text: Delete a pathogen with risk factors and suspected causes
Delete request with an unknown pathogen id
Delete a pathogen that nothing references

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; the pathogen is soft-deleted
Its risk factors and suspected causes are soft-deleted in the same transaction
Rows of other pathogens stay untouched
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Pathogen ID not found' error; nothing is deleted

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing pathogen is returned as a failed Result
